about_the_game:
GAMEPLAY & FEATURES 

  • Short and sweet(?) doujin VN with 2.5+ hours till credits 

  • Multiple choices, a “true” heroine, and good and bad endings 

  • Star-studded cast of professional voice talent 

STORY 

Work up the courage to ask out your longtime library crush, Shiori Yomoda—if you can survive the chaos. 

Just as you’re ready to shoot your shot, mean girls Maika, Rin, and Aoi swoop in with a twisted new game: “Kokuhaku Confessional.” You’re the prized pig in this flirt-fueled battlefield, and they’re determined to knock you off course with teasing, temptation, and nonstop distractions! 

Can you resist their brazen charms and stay true to Shiori? Or will you fall for one of their traps along the way? 

Survive to the end without giving in—and maybe, just maybe, you’ll win Shiori’s heart. 

...“Kokuhaku Confessional”? 

It’s a new campus contest where girls “confess” their feelings to you—the first girl to score a yes wins the game! Is this a battle for love... or just a diversion for the bored and beautiful? 

CHARACTERS

Maika Kirishima 

Kanoko 

Known for her striking looks and steady stream of admirers. Beneath her beauty, her sharp tongue and mean-girl reputation often leave others second-guessing. Addicted to drama, it was Maika who came up with “Kokuhaku Confessional,” if only to keep herself entertained. 

In the past, you completely misread her signals and asked her out, only to be savagely rejected. 

Rin Kuraishi 

Haruru Akiyama 

Your classmate and Maika’s best friend, Rin stands out with her refined, calm demeanor, drawing attention from boys in a way that neatly contrasts with Maika’s boldness. However, behind her good-girl facade lies a shocking secret. 

Indifferent to playing “Kokuhaku Confessional” at first, she becomes intrigued after seeing Maika experience rejection firsthand. 

Aoi Shimasaki 

Ryo Suzuki 

The third member of Maika’s posse, Aoi has known you for years. However, her towering stature and assertive personality make her intimidating to be around, so you’ve been keeping your distance. 

Under her tough exterior, Aoi hides a deep, unspoken affection for you—feelings so strong that she hasn’t fully realized them yet. 

Shiori Yomoda 

Kasumi Yuki 

A senior at your campus’s library club, Shiori is shy and introverted but shares many of your otaku special interests, sparking frequent conversations between you two. 

She’s been a surprising source of comfort and encouragement after Maika shot you down, and you’ve been crushing on her in secret ever since.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains occasional crude humor and crass language. All characters are 18 years of age or older.
